brief.aim: The table holds seven continuous kernel-geometry measurements (area, perimeter, compactness, kernel length/width, asymmetry coefficient, groove length) with no categorical or numeric outcome column, so no supervised target can be named without inventing one; the rows are individual seeds, i.e. static entities to be segmented, which makes unsupervised clustering the defensible aim. All columns are legitimate features of the same kind, none is an identifier or a recoding of an outcome, and there is no subject or chronological key to constrain partitioning.
brief.repeated_subjects: None evident; each row appears to be a distinct kernel with no subject or recording key.
brief.unit: one wheat kernel seed (one row of geometric measurements)
